entities.summary: Donald Curry, is an American former professional boxer who competed between 1980 and 1997. He has held world championships in two weight classes, including the undisputed and the Ring magazine welterweight titles between 1983 and 1986 and, the WBC light middleweight title from 1988 to 1989. He also challenged once for the IBF middleweight title in 1990. In 2019, he was inducted into the International Boxing Hall of Fame.
